builds.d: A build that increases skill hits and generates additional water ripples, boosting DMG and mark infliction.
A survival build that grants shields after casting a skill and randomly restores squadmates' Energy.

l.b: Increases Skill DMG. Also triggers an additional surge of waves that inflict ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.
l.s: Increases the damage of Limpid Stream (Main Skill) by ⟦0⟧. Also triggers a surge of waves, dealing ⟦1⟧ as Aqua Skill DMG and inflicting ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.

l.b: Adds a second phase to the Skill. When cast at the right moment, applies a bonus effect.
l.s: Adds a second phase to the Skill, dealing ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ as Aqua Skill DMG. If the second phase is cast after a 0.3s delay, increases its Attack Range by 30% and boosts the target's Aqua DMG Taken by ⟦3⟧ for 6s.

l.b: When Teresa deals Skill DMG, increases the squad's ATK.
l.s: When Teresa deals Skill DMG, increases the squad's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 6s, stacking up to 5 times. This effect can only be triggered once per strike.

l.b: When Teresa deals Skill DMG, increases the squad's Resilience Break Efficiency.
l.s: When Teresa deals Skill DMG, increases the squad's Resilience Break Efficiency by ⟦0⟧ for 6s, stacking up to 5 times.

l.b: When Teresa deals Skill DMG, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken.
l.s: When Teresa deals Skill DMG, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 6s. If the target does not have broken resilience, increases their Aqua DMG Taken by ⟦1⟧ instead.

l.b: When Teresa gains a Surging Shield, unleashes a surge of waves and inflicts ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.
l.s: When Teresa gains a Surging Shield, unleashes a surge of waves, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Aqua Skill DMG, and inflicts ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩.

l.b: When Limpid Stream (Main Skill) inflicts ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩, there is a chance to grant energy to a random Aqua squadmate.
l.s: When Limpid Stream (Main Skill) inflicts ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩, there is a 50% chance to grant ⟦0⟧ Energy to 1 Aqua squadmate.

l.b: When a squadmate casts a Support Skill or Ultimate Skill, Teresa gains a Surging Shield.
l.s: When a squadmate casts a Support Skill or Ultimate Skill, Teresa gains a Surging Shield equal to ⟦0⟧ of Base ATK for 5s.

l.b: When Teresa gains a Surging Shield, increases the squad's ATK.
l.s: When Teresa gains a Surging Shield, increases the squad's ATK by 7%/11%/15%/19%/23%/27%<color=#ec6d21></color> for 5s, stacking up to 3 times.

l.b: Increases Skill DMG.  When a squadmate hits a target with ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩, reduces the Cooldown of Limpid Stream (Main Skill).
l.s: Increases Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧.  When a squadmate hits a target with ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩, reduces the Cooldown of Limpid Stream (Main Skill) by 1s. This effect can only be triggered once every 4s.

l.b: For each Aqua Trekker on the squad, increases the squad's ATK.
l.s: For each Aqua Trekker on the squad, increases the squad's ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Any of Teresa's attacks can stun targets.
l.s: Any of Teresa's attacks can stun targets for 2s. This effect can only be triggered once every ⟦0⟧s.

l.b: When Teresa gains a Surging Shield, increases her Auto Attack DMG.
l.s: When Teresa gains a Surging Shield, increases her Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 8s.

l.b: When Slicing Riptide (Ultimate) deals DMG to targets, reduces their Movement SPD and increases their Aqua DMG Taken. When it hits a friendly unit, increases their resistance to interruption.
l.s: When Slicing Riptide (Ultimate) deals DMG to targets, reduces their Movement SPD by 90%, and increases their Aqua DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧. When it hits a friendly unit, increases their resistance to interruption for 20s.

l.b: When casting the Ultimate, increases the squad's ATK.
l.s: When casting Slicing Riptide (Ultimate), increases the squad's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 20s.

l.b: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt to targets with ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩/⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩.
l.s: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt of Slicing Riptide (Ultimate) to targets with ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩/⟨Chill⟩/⟨Freeze⟩ by ⟦0⟧.

A build that creates a Tidal Domain to knock back enemies and boost the main Trekker's DMG within the area, ideal for a ranged main Trekker.
